The `UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred because `TokenVault` generates an Android Keystore key configured with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(30, ...)`. Calling `vault.save(token)` directly when the user taps "Sign in" attempted to use the authenticated key without first prompting the user for biometric or device-credential authentication within the validity window.

### Fix
In [`MainActivity.kt`](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt), wrapped the session token storage inside an authentication check using `BiometricPrompt` configured with `BIOMETRIC_STRONG or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL`. Upon successful authentication, the user is authorized to perform cryptographic operations with the Keystore key and `vault.save(token)` executes securely.
